subject: Security Notification: transient telemetry spike — evidence & IR plan request
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Eileen Chan <eileen.chan@pioneerhealth.com>, PioneerHealth Security Team <security@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Security Notification: transient telemetry spike — evidence & IR plan request

Hi Eileen / PioneerHealth security team,

Quick heads-up from our ops monitoring team: between 2028-03-29 22:05 UTC and 2028-03-29 22:18 UTC we observed a short-lived telemetry spike affecting a small subset of requests from your tenant (request IDs included in the attached snapshot). We have no indication of successful exfiltration or PHI exposure, and the anomaly appears tied to a misrouted debug flag during a brief rollout.

To support PioneerHealth's internal review and your SOC 2 / SIG mapping, can you confirm the evidence pathway you prefer? Options we can support today:
- SFTP drop (pre-authorized account)
- Shared Drive with time-limited link (we can redact sensitive headers)
- Encrypted bundle via our secure upload portal (preferred for audit shipments)

Attached: pioneerhealth_telemetry_snaps.zip (CSV snapshots + truncated request IDs) and a redacted incident summary draft.

Requesting:
- Your preferred delivery method and SFTP credentials or Drive mailbox
- Any specific artifact formats for SIG/CAIQ mapping (we can provide an XLS mapping)
- Whether you want our full IRP excerpt or a redacted summary for now

I'll loop in the security/product folks internally to prepare the IR artifacts and a short timeline. Goal: get a curated package to you within 24 hours.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
Attachment: pioneerhealth_telemetry_snaps.zip (csv)
Attachment: redacted_irp_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Eileen Chan <eileen.chan@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: PioneerHealth Security Team <security@pioneerhealth.com>, Markus Richter <m.richter@auditfirm.io>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security Notification: transient telemetry spike — evidence & IR plan request

Neha — thanks for the quick flag and the initial package. Appreciate the transparency.

We confirm:
- Please deliver via shared Drive link with view/download enabled for security@pioneerhealth.com.
- Include an IRP excerpt that outlines containment steps and timeline; redacted is fine, but include exact timestamps (UTC) and the set of affected request IDs.
- For SIG/CAIQ review our auditor (Markus Richter) prefers CSV + XLS mapping; if you can populate the SIG question IDs where relevant (e.g., CC6, SI4) that speeds validation.

One ask: because this involves our production tenant, we need chain-of-custody metadata for the telemetry bundle (who pulled the data, checksums, transfer method, redaction notes). Can you include that in the package?

Target for our side: initial acknowledgement and review within 24 hours of receiving the Drive link. If you think this will take longer than the 24-hour window, let us know ASAP.

Thanks,
Eileen
Eileen Chan
Director, Information Security
PioneerHealth
